newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NAB cuts business rate 40 basis pts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NAB cuts business rate 40 basis pts.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd said in Friday it would cut its lending rate to major corporate customers by 40 basis points to 9.85 percent, effective November 11.
National Australia said it would cut its rate for other business borrowers by 50 basis points to 10.25 percent, effective December 16.
NAB said the reductions follow movements in the money market and this week's cut in official interest rates by the Reserve Bank of Australia.
Commonwealth Bank of Australia earlier on Friday cut its prime business rate by 50 basis points to 9.75 percent.
